subject.title: fix(text): harden string helpers against small/degenerate inputs

question: May requester grouping collapse repeated trailing `[bot]` suffixes while mutation authorization continues to require an exact submitted actor identity?
rationale: The code and regression test preserve the fail-closed mutation gate, but only maintainers can confirm that the broader grouping semantics are intentional for malformed identities.

options.title: Approve the scoped grouping change
options.body: Confirm that repeated suffixes may normalize only for requester grouping while raw actor equality remains mandatory for mutation authorization.

options.title: Keep single-suffix grouping
options.body: Reject the grouping expansion and retain the existing normalizer if malformed identities must remain distinct everywhere.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped grouping change
recommendation.body: Confirm that repeated suffixes may normalize only for requester grouping while raw actor equality remains mandatory for mutation authorization.
